description: Original cat philosophy mixed with short, attributed passages from public-domain philosophical works. Source URLs are editorial references; the app uses the bundled text offline.

quotes.text: The bowl is full. The void remains.
quotes.author: Puke

quotes.text: I chased the red dot. It was never mine.
quotes.author: Puke

quotes.text: Even the sunbeam leaves without saying goodbye.
quotes.author: Puke

quotes.text: One day, the box will outlast us.
quotes.author: Puke

quotes.text: The universe expands. My territory does not.
quotes.author: Puke

quotes.text: The eternal silence of these infinite spaces frightens me.
quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.text: While we are postponing, life speeds by.
quotes.author: Seneca
quotes.work: Moral Letters to Lucilius, I.2; Richard M. Gummere translation

quotes.text: Of a truth, need and boredom are the two poles of human life.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.work: Studies in Pessimism, On the Sufferings of the World; T. Bailey Saunders translation

quotes.text: Smoke and ash and a tale, or not even a tale.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Every goodbye is forever. Until you come back.
quotes.author: Roof

quotes.text: I brought the ball. It did not answer my questions.
quotes.author: Roof

quotes.text: The doorbell tolls for all of us.
quotes.author: Roof

quotes.text: You are my whole world. It is a small, wonderful world.
quotes.author: Roof

quotes.text: I have been in this position before.
quotes.author: Rock

quotes.text: Change is inevitable. Give me a million years.
quotes.author: Rock

quotes.text: I used to be a mountain. We all make compromises.
quotes.author: Rock
